phase: US financial V5 — private PostgreSQL TEST promotion foundation

invariants.promotion: Living versioned PG TEST grant and policy; workspace/config/ERPhead/grant locks; actual ERP4 baseline and chronology; SQL canonical SHA-256 parity; owner provenance and all legacy receipt keys retained atomically. Full empty-event book only.
invariants.receipt: One immutable imported namespace; retained legacy actor/hash/revision, exact promotion hash/book binding; failed deferred completeness rolls transaction back. Legacy command bodies cannot all be regenerated from baseline.
invariants.authority: Trusted callback pre/post RPC; captured private JSON before awaits; revocation wins over malformed or failed responses, including final receipt hash checks. Historical actor timestamp is provenance, not freshness. PG grant is separate from D1/Auth/Stripe.
invariants.legacy: In-place RPC guards, no renamed bypass. Core/source/sidecar readers and writes reject promoted tenants rather than expose stale ERP4 current data. Direct writes check OLD/NEW tenants. Confirmed immutable CH jurisdiction preserves ordinary edits at RC/RR/SERIALIZABLE; US/unconfirmed legacy non-RC explicitly refused.
invariants.maintenance: TRUNCATE always refused on guarded tables, including shared/CH/nonpromoted tables. This global administrative restriction needs operational review before any approved hosted rollout.
invariants.security: RLS active, PUBLIC/anon/authenticated denied. No new SECURITY DEFINER or bypass GUC. Existing NOLOGIN admission owner gets only marker organization_id SELECT and required guard EXECUTE, no grant/book/receipt or service_role membership.
invariants.capability: Events and financial_v5 receipt inserts always PF010; no runtime flag opens append. Separate adapter has read/receipt/promote only; public/natives unchanged.
invariants.budgets: SQL independently limits 4MiB JSONB text, depth20, 50000 nodes, array1000, 524288 UTF8 bytes per key/string and 2097152 cumulative key/string UTF8 bytes. Conservative vs TS UTF16 budgets; no commercial capacity claim.

newAdapter.rpc: Synthetic mock responses; not a hosted integration test

newPostgres.migrations: 25 existing migrations plus additive foundation; real PostgreSQL WASM local execution
newPostgres.storage: NodeFS retained directory; same dataDir clean close/reopen verifies exact book, legacy receipts, promotion retry and freeze

uiAndNative.reason: Backend-only private foundation; no changed page/route or native code

intermediate: Initial TypeScript checks identified mock RPC typing and PG callback implicit-any errors; corrected and global nonincremental check rerun successfully.
Review corrected receipt-to-book binding and unconditional revocation postflight; dedicated adapter tests included.
PG review corrected NOLOGIN marker visibility with minimum privileges, CH non-RC compatibility and both old-snapshot and RC TRUNCATE races; final run covers corrected source.
PGlite serializes transactions, so targeted tests and lock review do not establish real multi-connection execution, crash recovery, performance or SLA.
